title: Recipient tokens
description: Turn addresses into removable recipients without breaking typing flow.
useCase: Turn addresses into removable recipients without breaking typing flow.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Accepts display names, not email validation; up to five recipients. No message is sent.
look: Pale blue-grey page with a white rounded compose card: pale recipient chips with pastel initial avatars and remove crosses, a bold subject and grey body.
motion: A committed recipient becomes a token that fades and scales in from 0.92 over 160 ms ease-out; removal has no exit animation, and keyboard-driven commits skip the entrance.
adapt: Tokens enter with the `sf-recipient-tokens-recipientIn` keyframe (160ms ease-out on `.token`); `insert` trims, dedupes and caps at five, and Backspace on an empty field removes the last. Replace the `names` seed and add real address validation.
